title: This Free GitHub Skill Makes Your AI Agent Design Properly
description:
Agents write great code but their landing pages? Ugly walls of text 😅

Someone published "ai design skills" on GitHub, ready made skills for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. You drop the md file in your project and the agent asks you questions itself, then picks fonts, layout and builds sections.

Search elaya design ai design skills on GitHub ✨🔥
